2 . When educating a new client about nutrition for their child to promote heart health, which statement should 
be included? 
a. “Use only breast milk for the first 6 months of life.” 
b. “At six months, pureed vegetables can be added to the infant’s diet.” 
c. “You can give your infant 100% fruit juice.” 
d. “Healthy eating habits cannot start until later.” 
3 . When teaching a client about healthy snack choices for their child to promote heart health, which snack 
choice would be the most appropriate? 
a. Fruit flavored snacks 
b. Whole milk 
c. Banana 
d. Ice cream 
4 . For a client who is following a heart healthy diet, what is the recommended sodium intake? 
a. < 1500 mg/day 
b. < 2300 mg/day 
c. < 3000 mg/day
